# `user` tools

5 tools in the `user` operation domain. This reference covers every tool the server registers, including the ones a default deployment does not expose. See the [tool reference index](index.md) for every domain.

The Summary column on each domain page is the first line of the tool's MCP description. The complete text, including the conditions under which a tool refuses, is the tool handler's docstring under `src/hmcpctl/server_tools/`. An MCP client's `tools/list` carries that docstring's prose as the description and its argument detail in the input schema; `Returns:` and `Raises:` sections are not sent.

| Tool | Effect | Operation | Target | Implementation | Verification | Runtime eligibility | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `hmc_create_user` | `mutate` | `user.create` | `user` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Create a documented UOM UserProfile below a management console. |
| `hmc_delete_user` | `destructive` | `user.delete` | `user` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Permanently delete a UOM UserProfile identified by UUID. |
| `hmc_get_user` | `read` | `user.get` | `user` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Get a UserProfile by its management-console and profile UUIDs. |
| `hmc_list_users` | `read` | `user.list` | `console` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | List UserProfile children of a management console. |
| `hmc_modify_user` | `mutate` | `user.modify` | `user` | `implemented` | `stale (closure-changed)` | `existing-runtime-guards` | Modify supplied fields of a UOM UserProfile identified by UUID. |
